text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (specifically Oligoarticular JIA). The clinical presentation of severe nocturnal pain, significant swelling, and failure to respond to NSAIDs in a 24-year-old is highly suggestive of an inflammatory etiology, distinguishing it from septic arthritis (usually acute) or gout (less common to present this way at this age without prior episodes). Given the chronicity and severity, a rheumatologic origin like JIA is the leading hypothesis until proven otherwise by imaging and inflammatory markers.
